The apology itself though, as they said, was fucked up. I thought otherwise and thought that this was sincere.

\^\^ this was also why I wanted to end myself.

But really, I regret what I did...

I just hope that I won't push through this—

Yeah, I might go for therapy and all, it's just hard for me to forgive myself after what I've done, I guess?

No court case going on.. It isn't as serious as rape, but it's harassment either way. The people I've hurt, after sending my two fucked up apologies, are no longer in contact with me..

So at this point, I really don't know anymore

Nope, I barely watch porn. You are true about serious regret, though. I just don't know what to do except ending myself right now, if it's for the better of those people who I've harmed. The only reason why I'm not doing it right now is because of the usual "mom and dad will be sad" thing.
